geography: United States (PTC net product revenue of Emflaza; Emflaza is sold in the U.S.)

approval_evidence.quote: NDA208684 / NDA208685 EMFLAZA (DEFLAZACORT), ORIG submission 1, submission_status AP, submission_status_date 20170209 (Drugs@FDA via openFDA)

launch_evidence.quote: In May 2017, Emflaza became commercially available in the U.S.

series_start_reason: Emflaza was approved in February 2017 for Marathon Pharmaceuticals; PTC completed the acquisition of all rights on April 20, 2017 (10-Q for June 30, 2017) and Emflaza became commercially available in May 2017, so PTC's first quarter, 2017Q2, is the launch quarter (a partial quarter of sales).
search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1070081 (PTC Therapeutics) via data.sec.gov/submissions; fetched every 10-Q/10-K and every exhibit of each 8-K with item 2.02 filed 2014-01 to 2026-11 and searched for 'Emflaza'. The 10-Q/10-K statements of operations print only total 'Net product revenue' (Translarna plus Emflaza), and their 'Emflaza' table rows are expense lines; the 10-Q for March 31, 2018 states U.S. product sales of $19.2 million 'consisting solely of emflaza'.

Every quarter is read from the financial-highlights text of that quarter's own earnings release (8-K Ex. 99.1): 'Emflaza net product sales were $X million for the ... quarter of YYYY' (2017Q2-2018Q1) and 'Emflaza net product revenue(s) were/was ...' thereafter, in $ millions to one decimal.

Checks: full years stated in Q4 releases - 2017 '$28.8 million' (2.1 + 9.8 + 17.0 = 28.9, rounding); 2018 '$92.0 million' (19.2 + 20.3 + 22.6 + 29.8 = 91.9); 2019 '$101 million' (101.0); 2020 '$139.0 million' (139.0); 2021 '$187.3 million' (187.2); 2022 '$218.3 million' (218.3); 2023 '$255.1 million' (255.1); 2024 '$207.2 million' (207.2); 2025 '$146.4 million' (146.5). The prior-year comparison quoted in each release equals the row recorded for that earlier quarter.
